name: Image generation (Image Playground)
plain: Creates stylised images on device from prompts.
meaning: iOS offers Image Playground and Genmoji through a system sheet. Android has no equivalent first party app API for images.

android.note: Gemini app and Pixel Studio are first party apps, not APIs for developers.

ios.note: Image created in system UI; the app gets the result only.

limits.headline: Can offer picture creation through Apple's Image Playground sheet, and sees only the result
limits.user_action: You tap a button like Create image, then describe what you want in the Apple sheet
can: Open Apple's Image Playground sheet inside the app
Receive the finished picture you choose
Work on iPhones with Apple Intelligence turned on
cannot: See your prompt text or the other ideas you rejected, only the final picture
Run on iPhones without Apple Intelligence
Use Pixel Studio or the Gemini app on Android as a developer tool; they are not offered to apps
limits.differs: iPhone apps can use Image Playground from iOS 18.2. Android has no tool for developers to do this.

story.what_it_is: Makes stylized pictures on the phone from a text prompt, through a system screen.

marketing.name: Image Playground
marketing.pitch: Apple pitches Image Playground as a fun way to create images from a description inside Apple Intelligence.

story.for_you: You type an idea in a system sheet and get a picture in a few styles. The app only gets the finished picture, not your prompt history.
story.for_makers: Makers add creative features without building their own image model. It keeps data on the device and under Apple rules, but they get no control over the model.

use_cases.example: A chat app lets you make a quick cartoon to send to a friend.
A notes or design app adds a sketch from a prompt.
A social app lets you build a stylized avatar.
A kids story app makes a picture for a page.
A school app creates a picture for a project cover.
A game could let you make a custom avatar or sticker.
A presentation app makes art for a slide.

story.android_note: No developer API. Gemini and Pixel Studio are Google's own apps.
story.ios_note: Needs Apple Intelligence. The picture is made in the system sheet.
